credential_fields.label: Personal Access Token
credential_fields.description: GoDaddy Personal Access Token (generated at developer.godaddy.com)

credential_fields.name: customer_id
credential_fields.label: Customer ID
credential_fields.description: GoDaddy account / shopper ID (optional, used for reseller contexts)

actions.description: Fetch DNS records for a GoDaddy-managed domain.

parameters.name: record_type
parameters.description: Filter by record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV). Omit for all types.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter by record name (e.g. @ or www). Requires record_type.

actions.description: Create or update a DNS record for a GoDaddy-managed domain. Snapshots the current value for rollback.

parameters.name: record_type
parameters.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Record name (@ for root, or subdomain like www)

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Record value (IP address, hostname, TXT string, etc.)

safety_notes: DNS changes propagate globally and may affect live traffic.
Previous record value is snapshotted for full rollback.
